_comment: Inference configuration for the merged-channel neurite/soma model: the same network and sliding window as params.json, four folds from leave-one-well-out training on frames merged by models/neurite_classical.merge_channels. These are NOT tunables: they are the configuration the held-out score was measured with, Dice 0.843 neurite / 0.879 soma, mean of four wells, leave-one-well-out over 15 frames.
